source.title: NOAA National Weather Service wind-direction convention
source.derivation: Average 1 mph and 21 mph linearly over 1000 ft, convert mph to ft/s, then multiply by the 100 s descent time.

comparison.decisionRule: Observed rounded drift and bearing equal the analytic interpolation reference.

notes: Analytic regression comparison only; not atmospheric or flight validation.
